lesson: The channel is main total_changes plus other total_changes, not main changes(). The source uses INSERT OR IGNORE with no trigger. The channel accumulates every direct row change on either connection, including changes inside transactions that are later rolled back, so it is the running total of successful inserts, updates, and deletes across both connections. Committed state is the net effect of committed operations only.
scope: Predicts channel, committed_count, and committed_sum for action sequences using put, update, delete, begin, commit, and rollback on main or other connections, assuming INSERT OR IGNORE, no trigger, and main total_changes plus other total_changes as the channel.
